mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer (customer_no, customer_name, customer_ssn, customer_mobile, customer_addr, customer_email) VALUES (#{customerNo}, #{customerName}, #{customerSsn}, #{customerMobile}, #{customerAddr}, #{customerEmail})
